rows: I respect your position. I would just like to know why you think it is permanent.
Brawling is a fine tool. I am sure you use it more gracefully than most people.
A risk is a bold move. I admire it, though I suspect it is not your own idea.
Slow is charming. I wish I had your patience, honestly.
The people deserve the best contest, and I am happy to let you show them yours.
Short version: I am glad you asked, and I am going to answer it my way.
I have had every opportunity, and I am grateful for it. Some of us had to earn ours.
Look at the stance. Beautiful. Very composed.
You say technique. You have clearly been well coached. Show me what you did yourself.
Strikes are impressive. I imagine someone helped you choose them.
A risk is a lovely gesture. I wonder whose gesture it really is.
A stall is an elegant choice. I admire that you have the freedom to make it.
The people deserve a contest that is earned, not arranged. I think they will see the difference.
You say you are among the best. I am sure that is a comfort to the people who helped you.
You are proud of your {strength}. Lovely. I wonder who taught you to be proud of it.
I have been admiring your {strength}, and I am curious about where it really comes from.
You kept calm. Very good. It is hard to keep calm when you are not sure of your ground.
Fair. You have made a fair point, and I will be fair back.
I could be rude about that. I would rather be pleasant and let the result speak.
One fall. Keep me down, and I will admit you were the better man.
On the mat I will be polite. It is the most dangerous thing I can offer.
Grounded or standing, I am still smiling, and I still mean it.
Stay in front of me. I would like to see what you do without help.
Good answer. It sounded like it was your own.
You have not answered. I am sure you have a good reason. Give it.
I accept that. I will be polite about it at the bell.
I will wrestle this match politely, and I will see who really holds the advantage.
My approach is courteous. You will see what that means on the night.
Whatever happens, I hope you will remember I was gracious about it.
It is not finished. I am still being polite.
I have one kind remark left, and you will hear it when the bell rings.
